description: This file contains unit tests for the BonjourEscapes decoding functionality within the OpenClawKit project. It verifies the correct handling of escape sequences in strings, including decoding spaces, multiple escapes, invalid sequences, and Unicode scalar values.

classes.name: BonjourEscapesTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that contains multiple test cases for the BonjourEscapes decoding functionality.

methods.name: decodePassThrough
methods.description: Tests that decoding a simple string without escape sequences returns the original string.

methods.name: decodeSpaces
methods.description: Verifies that escape sequence \032 is correctly decoded to a space character.

methods.name: decodeMultipleEscapes
methods.description: Checks decoding of a string with multiple escape sequences representing special characters.

methods.name: decodeIgnoresInvalidEscapeSequences
methods.description: Ensures that invalid escape sequences are returned as-is without decoding.

methods.name: decodeUsesDecimalUnicodeScalarValue
methods.description: Tests decoding of Unicode scalar values expressed in decimal escape sequences.
